problem_statement: Harden the Organization Agent Mesh inter-agent communication architecture for safe simultaneous operation of multiple unrelated projects, while preserving project-specific autonomy and synchronized deployable agent packages.
desired_outcome: A reusable, fail-closed, project-scoped communication and deployment control plane suitable for autonomous multi-project operation.
constraints: Do not modify peer project repositories from this project
Do not silently elevate agent authority
Recursive learning may observe peers read-only but may graft changes only into this project after local review
Slack is an optional scheduled-task transport and not canonical project state
Preserve at least 20 percent verified repository/artifact capacity for essential writes when a hard limit is known
Unknown repository/artifact capacity must never be interpreted as unlimited
Current human project intent and the local identity lock must be validated before continuation state becomes actionable
Durable persistence adapters must preserve atomic lease and compare-and-set semantics or fail closed
non_goals: Implement domain logic for Duo Open
Create shared mutable state between projects
Use Slack as canonical accepted state
Create a central controller that may mutate peer projects
assumptions: The uploaded Organization Agent Mesh v1.0.0 package is the seed baseline.
validation_methods: package identity readback and component-hash validation
approval_gates: Cross-project exchange remains denied unless explicitly approved/capability-granted
Recursive self-enhancement candidates require local evidence review and Primary acceptance before grafting
Outbound Slack delivery requires an explicit configured destination and external-communication authority
Consumption of reserved repository/artifact capacity is limited to essential canonical writes under local Primary authority
Project lifecycle transitions and accepted-state mutations remain scoped to the owning project
data_handling_rules: No peer-project secrets or project-instance private state in shared framework packages
Peer improvement snapshots retain provenance but must separate reusable mechanisms from domain-instance state
Do not publish secrets, credentials, MFA data, private keys, tokens, or unnecessary sensitive data to Slack
Cross-project capacity signals contain only high-level capacity metadata and enumerated need categories
Quarantine records preserve rejected-message evidence but are never executable input
prohibited_actions: Write to any peer repository during self-enhancement observation
Guess project identity for mutating operations
Guess a Slack destination for scheduled-task delivery
Invent a provider hard limit or treat an unknown capacity limit as unlimited
Use a peer capacity signal as authority to mutate that peer
Allow an unbound agent to mutate project state
Silently accept a stale state version
Allow a restarted execution instance to inherit an earlier instance-owned lease
external_dependencies: Optional connected Slack workspace for Slack-enabled scheduled-task delivery
success_criteria: Current project intent and identity lock are validated before continuation state or mutable work
Concurrent projects cannot accidentally route or mutate across namespaces
Agent packages fail validation when stale, foreign, identity-inconsistent, or component-corrupted
A third project can adopt the protocol without code changes to the core
Peer Artifactory improvements can be recursively discovered without any peer mutation authority
Scheduled tasks can publish project-bound Slack summaries without making Slack canonical state
Projects preserve a 20 percent verified capacity reserve and fail closed when capacity is unknown
Projects can exchange compact high-level capacity and need signals without shared mutable state
Routine agent writes are coalesced and unchanged artifact uploads are suppressed by digest
Child agents inherit project identity and receive fresh execution-instance identity
Project-scoped leases expire and recover without allowing a stale execution instance to renew them
One project can pause or drain without stopping unrelated projects
Acknowledgements distinguish transport receipt from accepted/started/completed execution
Malformed, unauthorized, incompatible, or expired messages do not enter normal execution and retain quarantine evidence
completion_definition: Identity lock/bootstrap controls, protocol controls, deployment packages, tests, documentation, capacity coordination, project lifecycle, lease/CAS controls, and delivery recovery are synchronized and release-gate validated.
